In summary, our research is concerned with
the following issues: - How to structure learning resources in a WBT system in a more general way than training oriented data structures?
the following research questions: (1) How can a global structuring mechanism be defined that is able to structure all learning resources in a WBT system?
the development of a new data model for learning resources and the implementation of this data model in the WBT-Master.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Knowledge Domains are a global structuring mechanism for learning resources in WBT systems.
the WBT-Master is the first WBT system that supports the global structuring of learning resources in terms of Knowledge Domains.
a Knowledge Domain is a global structuring mechanism of all learning resources provided in WBT-Master.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed and implemented the first WBT system that provides an "integrated" and "global" view on learning resources.
we developed a novel WBT architecture and system that is able to structure learning resources in a global manner.
we developed an approach to structure learning resources in WBT systems by means of Knowledge Domains and that we implemented this approach in the WBT-Master.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Knowledge Domain is the first data structure in a WBT system that is not "training oriented", but rather a global structuring mechanism of learning resources.
Knowledge Domains provide an additional global structuring mechanism for learning resources in WBT systems.
the global structure of learning resource can be perceived as a "meta-structure" of a WBT system.
